scientific_integrity: Analytic local Hopf expansion with exact rational sign witnesses; the code is corroboration rather than a proof. No claim about endemic attractors or global ecological basins.
scientific_limitations: Local to no-delay disease-free Hopf cycles in the stated positive-parameter specialization.
Invasion is a transverse linear exponent, not guaranteed endemic persistence.
Unindexed equivalent literature remains a priority risk.
title: Fear reverses the oscillatory infection-invasion shift in an Allee predator–prey model
